claims.sentence: The tools highlight areas on a prostate MRI scan where cancer might be present, which NICE says makes it easier for radiologists to spot and report.
Comments received during the consultation will be considered by the independent committee before final guidance is published.
NICE says the tools could help radiologists identify clinically significant prostate cancer more accurately and consistently, while helping NHS services manage growing demand for scans.
